job_text:
Data Analyst - Clearfield Insights

About the role
We help nonprofits make sense of their program data. You will build reports and dashboards that leaders use to make decisions every week.

Requirements
- Strong SQL skills for querying large datasets
- Experience building dashboards in Tableau
- Able to clean and prepare messy data in Excel
- Clear written communication for reporting findings

Nice to have
- Experience with Python for data analysis
- Familiarity with statistics and A/B testing
- Exposure to Google BigQuery

Benefits
- Health and dental coverage
- Annual learning budget
